declaration: scripts/ict-scan.py V_ICT is the code-side declaration of every value set below; scripts/tests/test_v_items_ict.py asserts the two are equal. The first value of every item is the baseline = v1 behaviour and the key's default.
n_formula: N = 1 baseline + sum over items of (len(values) - 1) + 1 combined = 1 + 39 + 1. Every item is ONE factor: the joint exit factor B-EXIT counts as one item of 24 value sets (23 non-baseline), B-LB as one item of 6 value sets (5 non-baseline). B-DISP is sensitivity-only and is not in this file or in N. B4 counts in N although implemented=false.

items.note: entry price on the FVG: iofed = near edge (v1), ce = 0.5 of the gap, fill = far edge
premium/discount range framing: r15 = nearest BSL/SSL pair (v1); r13 = swept extreme to opposing pool (the nearest unswept pool beyond the entry; keeps the r15 edge on that side when there is none)
on = PDH/PDL (UTC previous day) and Asian/London session highs/lows (session registry windows) join the pools; only completed days/sessions inside the window
stop buffer beyond the swept wick; ATR = simple mean true range over the 14 bars ending at the MSS bar (ATR_PERIOD is project-defined: the plan declares only the multiples)

items.source: models.md §2.1.5; core-b.md §2.12 (target); project (time stop H); models.md §3.1 rule 23 (2R)
items.note: ONE joint key, 3 x 4 x 2 = 24 value sets. H = bt.P[tf]['H'] bars (none = until the end of history); the 2R component skips simulate()'s planned-R:R entry floor (OPTS min_rr) for ICT trades only, so min_rr itself is not a second knob

<setup lookback>|<K-bar expiry>. 12 is the live default lookback (max(12, recent*6) at recent=2); 8 and 16 scale the live default by 8/12 and 16/12, so on 1m/5m (live default 24) they are 16 and 32 bars. K = bt.P[tf]['K']
yes = cancel the pending limit when the target trades before the limit fills (bars after the MSS up to, not including, the fill bar)

tfa_p5 reads the bias on the paired higher timeframe (1m<-15m, 5m<-1H, 15m<-4H, 1H<-1D) instead of the entry timeframe; an entry timeframe the table does not pair (30m, 2H, 4H, 1D) has no bias tier and refuses every setup

items.reason: the sources state 'a higher-timeframe level must be engaged before the LTF MSS' but never define what an HTF level is (swing, PDH/PDL, key level) or what 'engaged' means (touched, swept, inside a distance); any operationalisation would invent a rule or a threshold. No key is registered.

items.source: WMT p272 (as used by config B)
items.note: the existing OPTS knob: walk() moves the stop to entry at +1R when 'be'; no fx_ key was added
killzone = an index (asset_class 'indices') entry must fall inside a session-registry window (docs/architecture/sessions.json, DST-aware) at its fill bar; metals (XAUUSD) are never restricted
